title: Issue (out-of-scope capture: bug or plan)
description: A durable queue of defects and opportunities outside the current session scope, ready for a later session. The canonical content, filing, triage and closure rules are in skills/dev-docs/knowledge/issue.md.

issue_type.description: bug = a deviation from an existing specification, test or declared invariant. plan = a new opportunity, improvement or pending task.

subject_paths.description: Repository-relative target paths. dev-evidence uses overlap with the change surface to retrieve related issues.

disposition_target.description: Document ID identifying the resolving change, promoted ADR or design. Transitioning to done requires this field or disposition_reason.

disposition_reason.description: The resolution when no change is created, or the reason for rejection. Required when transitioning to rejected.
